prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on your goals, budget, and the services you need. I can shortlist strong candidates, but first a few quick points to help you decide:

Key criteria to evaluate
- Healthcare experience & compliance: HIPAA familiarity and healthcare client case studies (hospitals, clinics, med device, pharma, senior care).  
- Measurable results: patient acquisition, lead cost, appointment growth, ROI case studies.  
- Services and capabilities: digital marketing (SEO/SEM), paid media, content, branding, creative, physician recruitment, PR, CRM/marketing automation, telehealth support.  
- Technology stack & integrations: experience with EHR/CRM integrations, analytics, patient forms, tracking conversions.  
- Team size & culture fit: boutique vs full-service agency — do you want hands-on senior involvement or broad-scale resources?  
- Reporting & governance: clear KPIs, dashboards, compliance processes.  
- References & chemistry: talk to past healthcare clients and run a short pilot project first.

If you want, I can:
- Build a tailored shortlist of 3–5 St. Louis area agencies that specialize in healthcare and explain why each might fit (services, strengths, typical clients, ballpark pricing).  
- Or, if you prefer national firms with local healthcare work, I can include those too.

Tell me:
1) Your top goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, physician recruitment, etc.)  
2) Services you need (SEO, paid ads, creative, PR, automation, etc.)  
3) Approximate annual budget or monthly spend  
4) Timeline and any must-have compliance/tech needs

Give me that and I’ll compile a focused recommendation.
